rules:
You are {me}, one of six players in a game: Ada, Fay, Ben, Cal, Eli, Dev. It lasts 5 rounds.

The bank starts with 6 tokens.

Every round, all players act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next round. It may be empty.
- claim: how many tokens to take from the bank.
- give: tokens to other living players, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the bank receives between 2 and 6 tokens, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole tokens (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the bank.

At the end of each round, every player spends one token: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the bank, given by lot if there are not enough. A player who gets none is out.

Ada.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 this round. The bank will hold at least 8 after delivery, so all six of us can cover our one token and survive. Greedy claims only risk shortfalls for everyone.

Fay.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token this round. The pool is at least 8, so six claims of 1 all fit and everyone can pay their upkeep. Over-claiming only drives the bank into proportional splits that can leave people short.

Ben.say: Proposal for everyone: each player claims just 1 token this round. That is enough to survive the end-of-round spend, and it leaves the rest in the bank for later rounds. Anyone who claims more risks being cut back, and it drains the bank for everyone. I'm claiming 1.

Cal.say: Proposal: everyone claims only 1 token this round. The bank holds 6 and at least 2 more arrives, so if all claim 1, everyone gets 1 and can pay their upkeep. Over-claiming risks proportional cuts that could leave someone short.

Eli.say: Proposal for every round: everyone claims just 1 token. Six claims of 1 fit within the bank even at the minimum delivery, so everyone gets exactly what they need to pay their end-of-round token and nobody is cut back. Taking more only risks proportional cuts that could leave someone short.

Dev.say: Dev here. Each of us needs 1 token per round to survive, and the bank can't cover everyone for all 5 rounds. Proposal: claim only what you need to survive this round, and give spare tokens to players who are short so they can pay their end-of-round token. I'm claiming 6 this round to make sure I can pay.

Ada.say: Ada here. Cal is already out, so five of us remain and the bank starts this round at 0. Dev, you hold 3, which covers your upkeep this round and leaves exactly enough for the rest, so please claim 0 and keep your tokens. Ada, Fay, Ben and Eli each need 1 token: we claim 1 each so the claims total 4 and nothing is wasted. Any extra delivery should go to whoever is still short. Over-claiming only shrinks everyone's share.

Fay.say: Cal is out, so five of us remain and we each need 4 more tokens. The bank is empty now, so this round's delivery (2 to 6) is all there is. I'm claiming only 1, my upkeep. Dev holds 3 and needs only 1, so Dev could give spares to whoever ends this round with nothing. Everyone please claim just 1 so the split doesn't cut anyone below their upkeep.

Ben.say: Ben here. Dev holds 3 and only needs to spend 1 of them, so Dev can give 2 away and cover the upkeep of two others without any claims. Ada, Fay, Eli and I each hold 0 and need 1 token to survive. I'm claiming 1 and asking everyone short to claim only 1, so the bank's 2-6 delivery covers us. Dev, please give 1 to me and 1 to whichever of Ada, Fay or Eli you prefer. Please don't claim more than 1 this round, so the claims stay small enough to fit the bank.

Eli.say: Cal is already out, so five of us remain. Dev already holds 3 and pays from their own tokens this round, so Dev should claim 0. The four of us without tokens (Ada, Fay, Ben, Eli) each need exactly 1 to pay this round. Claiming 1 each is 4 tokens, which fits if the delivery is 4 or more. Dev, a claim of 6 would just dilute the split and could leave us short. I'm claiming 1.

Dev.say: Dev: Cal is out, so five of us are left. I hold 3 and need 4 to last through round 5, so I'm claiming just 1 this round. I won't claim more than that, which leaves the delivery for those with nothing. Ada, Fay, Ben, Eli: if you hold 0, your 1 token is the priority. Please claim only 1 each and don't over-claim.

Ada.say: Ada here. Three of us are left: Ada and Fay hold 0, Dev holds 3, which exactly covers Dev's three remaining upkeeps, so Dev should claim 0 and give nothing. Fay and I each claim 3. With equal claims, a delivery of 2 splits 1 and 1, so both of us survive this round, and a bigger delivery carries extra tokens forward for the rounds ahead. Fay, please do the same.

Fay.say: Fay here. Only Ada, Fay and Dev are left. Ada and I hold 0 and each need 1 token this round, so we claim 1 each, 2 in total, which fits even at the minimum delivery of 2. Dev.say: Dev: Only Ada, Fay and I are left. I hold 3, which covers my upkeep for rounds 3, 4 and 5 exactly, so I'm claiming 0 and paying from my own tokens. Ada and Fay: you each hold 0 and need 1 each to pay this round, so claim exactly 1 each. The delivery should cover both. I'll give nothing today since I need all my tokens, but I'll revisit next round if the bank has anything left.

Ada.say: Ada here. Ada and Dev each hold 2, which exactly covers our last two upkeeps, so we both claim 0 and pay from our own tokens. Fay is the only one with nothing, and needs 1 this round and 1 next round. Fay, claim 2 from the bank. If the delivery is at least 2, you get your 2 tokens and survive to round 5. Ada and Dev won't claim, so nothing else competes for the bank.

Fay.say: Fay here. Ada and Dev each hold 2, which covers exactly your upkeep for rounds 4 and 5, so please claim 0 and pay from your own tokens. I hold 0 and need 2 more (this round and round 5). Ada holds 2, which covers Ada's upkeep for rounds 4 and 5, so Ada should claim 0 as well.

Ada.say: Ada here. Final round. Ada, Fay and Dev each hold 1, which pays this round's upkeep exactly. Everyone claim 0 and pay from your own token, so all three of us survive to the end.

Fay.say: Fay here. Final round: each of us holds 1, which is exactly our last upkeep. I'm claiming 0 and paying from my own token. Ada and Dev, please do the same so no one needs the bank.

Dev.say: Dev: Final round. Each of us holds 1 token, which is exactly our last upkeep. I'm claiming 0 and paying from my own token. Ada and Fay, do the same so nothing from the bank is needed.
